mechanism_narrative: A persistently low federal funds rate (below 0.5%) indicates an accommodative monetary policy stance that reduces the cost of capital for corporations, leading to higher equity valuations and positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are negative in more than 60% of periods when FEDFUNDS <= 0.5%, or the Rank IC falls below 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A high unemployment rate (above 9.0%) signals a weak labor market that suppresses consumer spending and corporate earnings growth, resulting in negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day returns are positive in more than 60% of periods when UNRATE > 9.0, or the Rank IC is below 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous increase in housing starts (HOUST) and industrial production (INDPRO) above their respective thresholds indicates a broad-based economic recovery, driving positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day returns are negative in more than 60% of periods when both HOUST > 600 and INDPRO > 96, or the Rank IC is below 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: In a low-inflation regime (CPIAUCSL < 220.0), a near-zero federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS <= 0.5%) indicates an aggressive monetary policy response to deflationary risks, which stimulates equity market returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are negative in more than 60% of periods when CPIAUCSL < 220.0 and FEDFUNDS <= 0.5, or the Rank IC is below 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A low level of payroll employment (PAYEMS < 132000) signals a weak labor market that suppresses consumer spending and corporate earnings growth, resulting in negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in more than 60% of periods when PAYEMS < 132000, or the Rank IC is below 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A decline in industrial production (INDPRO) below 96.0 indicates a contraction in manufacturing output, which reduces corporate profits and leads to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day returns are positive in more than 60% of periods when INDPRO < 96.0, or the Rank IC is below 0.03 over any 1-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: In a housing recovery regime (HOUST > 600), a strong retail sales level (RSAFS > 350000) indicates robust consumer spending that boosts corporate earnings and drives positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day returns are negative in more than 60% of periods when HOUST > 600 and RSAFS > 350000, or the Rank IC is below 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A strong retail sales level (RSAFS > 340000) signals robust consumer demand that supports corporate earnings growth, resulting in positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day returns are negative in more than 60% of periods when RSAFS > 340000, or the Rank IC is below 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window.
